Method of Attack: Exploitation of insecure permissions on registry keys RpcEptMapper and DnsCache to trick RPC Endpoint Mapper service to load malicious DLLs

Local privilege escalation by creating a Performance subkey and triggering performance monitoring to execute code in the context of Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) service running with LOCAL SYSTEM permissions
Attack Vector: Local attacker exploiting misconfigured service registry keys
Indicators of Compromise: open-source exploit tool available since February 2021
